service_architecture.communication: In-process function calls; async via queue for background jobs
service_architecture.error_handling: Structured exceptions with logging; all errors surfaced explicitly
service_architecture.reason: Starting monolithic reduces operational complexity. Clear service boundaries allow extraction to microservices later without full rewrite.

api_architecture.reason: API versioning protects consumers from breaking changes. Pydantic contracts enforce type safety at the boundary.

database_architecture.strategy: Repository pattern — business logic never queries DB directly
database_architecture.indexing: Primary keys + foreign keys + query-specific indexes
database_architecture.backup: Automated JSON export on every write for SQLite projects
database_architecture.reason: Repository pattern isolates DB-specific code so the storage engine can be swapped (SQLite → PostgreSQL) without touching business logic.

event_architecture.async: asyncio for I/O-bound; threading for CPU-bound
event_architecture.reason: Event-driven design decouples producers from consumers, enabling future addition of listeners without modifying existing code.

security_architecture.data_protection: Sensitive fields hashed (bcrypt); secrets via environment variables
security_architecture.input_validation: All user input validated before processing (whitelist approach)
security_architecture.audit_trail: All mutations logged with timestamp, actor, and before/after state
threat_model: Secret leakage → env vars, never hardcoded
security_architecture.reason: Security-first architecture prevents retrofitting security as an afterthought. Each layer defends independently so a single failure does not compromise the system.

deployment_architecture.ci_cd: GitHub Actions — test → lint → build → deploy
deployment_architecture.scaling: Horizontal scaling behind load balancer when containerised
deployment_architecture.rollback: Git tag per release; Docker image per version
deployment_architecture.reason: Docker ensures environment parity between dev and prod. Tagged releases enable instant rollback without downtime.

communication_architecture.external: HTTP REST (JSON) for API projects; N/A otherwise
communication_architecture.async_tasks: asyncio event loop for I/O concurrency
communication_architecture.reason: JSON serialisation maximises interoperability. Synchronous internal calls keep the codebase simple until async is genuinely needed.

principles: Separation of concerns — each module has one responsibility
Dependency inversion — high-level modules do not depend on low-level details
Open/closed principle — extend via new modules, not by modifying existing ones
Fail-fast — invalid state raises an explicit error immediately
Transparency — every decision is logged with reasoning
Security-first — security is a layer, not an afterthought
